properties.name: PayloadRemovalDisallowed
properties.description:
If present and set to `true`, the user can't delete the profile unless the profile has a removal password and the user provides it.

On macOS 10.15 and later, this key only affects removal of _manually_ installed profiles. If set to `true` and no profile removal payload is present, removing the profile requires admin auth.

On macOS versions prior to 10.15, this key prevents admins from removing MDM installed profiles. However, as of macOS 10.15, users can never remove MDM profiles, not even the admin.

On iOS users can't remove a MDM profile.

Requires a supervised device.

properties.name: PayloadScope
properties.description: A string that defines whether to install the profile for the system or the user. In many cases, it determines the location of certificate items, such as keychains. Though it's not possible to declare different payload scopes, payloads like VPN can automatically install their items in both scopes, if needed.

properties.name: RemovalDate
properties.description: The date when the system automatically removes the profile.

properties.name: DurationUntilRemoval
properties.description: The number of seconds until the profile is automatically removed. If the `RemovalDate` key is present, the system uses whichever field yields the earliest date.

properties.name: PayloadExpirationDate
properties.description: The date when a profile is no longer valid and the system presents an update button to the user.

properties.name: TargetDeviceType
properties.description:
The type of platform of the target device. Specifying the platform type helps prevent unintended installations.

For interactive installations on iOS devices, specifying a target platform avoids interstitial alerts that prompt the user to choose a profile target when multiple targets are eligible.

Allowed values:

- `0`: Any/unspecified
- `1`: iPhone/iPad/iPod Touch
- `2`: Apple Watch
- `3`: HomePod
- `4`: Apple TV
- `5`: Mac
- `6`: Vision Pro

properties.name: ConsentText
properties.description:
A dictionary that includes:

- A key that contains the IETF BCP 47 identifier for a language, such as _en_ or _jp_
- A value that contains the agreement localized to language specified by the key

The dictionary can also contain an optional key, `default`, with its value consisting of the unlocalized (usually in _en_) agreement.

The system always displays the agreement in a dialog, and the user needs to agree before the system can install the profile.

The system chooses a localized version in the order of preference that the user specifies in macOS, or based on the user's current language setting in iOS. If there's no exact match, the system uses the default localization. If there's no default localization, the system uses the _en_ localization. If there's no _en_ localization, the system uses the first available localization.

> Tip:
> Provide a default value, if possible. The system won't display a warning if the user's locale doesn't match any localization in the `ConsentText` dictionary.

children.name: ConsentTextItem
children.description: The dictionary containing a key that consists of the IETF BCP 47 identifier for a language (for example, en or jp) and a value that consists of the agreement localized to that language.

children.name: ANY
children.description: The key consisting of the IETF BCP 47 identifier for a language (for example, en or jp) and the value consisting of the agreement localized to that language.

properties.name: AllowCacheDelete
properties.description: If true, the system purges content from the cache automatically when it needs disk space for other apps when free disk space runs low on the computer. Set to `false` to maximize effectiveness of Content Caching.

properties.name: AllowPersonalCaching
properties.description:
If `true`, the system caches the user's iCloud data. Changes to this value don't have an immediate effect. Clients may take some time, such as hours or days, to react to changes.

> Note:
> At least one of the `AllowPersonalCaching` or `AllowSharedCaching` keys need to be `true`.

properties.name: AllowSharedCaching
properties.description:
If `true`, the system caches non-iCloud content, such as apps and software updates. Changes to this value don't have an immediate effect. Clients may take some time, such as hours or days, to react to changes.

> Note:
> At least one of the `AllowPersonalCaching` or `AllowSharedCaching` keys need to be `true`.

properties.name: AutoActivation
properties.description:
If `true`, the system automatically activates the content cache when possible and prevents disabling it. If `allowContentCaching` is `false`, `AutoActivation` is also `false`.

Removing a profile that set `AutoActivation` to `true` doesn't deactivate the Content Cache.

properties.name: AutoEnableTetheredCaching
properties.description: If `true`, the system automatically enables Internet connection sharing when possible and prevent disabling Internet connection sharing. `DenyTetheredCaching` overrides `AutoEnableTetheredCaching`. Tethered caching requires Content Caching.

properties.name: CacheLimit
properties.description: The maximum number of bytes of disk space to use for the content cache. Set to `0` for unlimited disk space.

properties.name: DataPath
properties.description:
The path to the directory used to store cached content. Changing this setting manually doesn't automatically move cached content from the old location to the new one. To move content automatically, use the Sharing preference's Content Caching pane. The value must be (or end with) `/Library/Application Support/Apple/AssetCache/Data`.

The system creates a directory and its intermediates for the given data path if it doesn't already exist. The directory is owned by `_assetcache:_assetcache` and has mode 0750. Its immediate parent directory (`.../Library/Application Support/Apple/AssetCache`) is owned by `_assetcache:_assetcache` and has mode `0755`.

properties.name: DenyTetheredCaching
properties.description: If `true`, the system disables tethered caching.

properties.name: DisplayAlerts
properties.description: If `true`, Content Caching displays exceptional conditions (alerts) as system notifications in the upper corner of the screen. The device automatically displayed alerts starting in macOS 10.13. In macOS 10.15 the alerts are off by default, but still available through this setting.

properties.name: KeepAwake
properties.description: If `true`, the system prevents the computer from sleeping as long as Content Caching is on (System Preferences > Sharing > Content Caching is on). Customers who want Content Caching to be as available as much as possible should turn this setting on.

properties.name: ListenRanges
properties.description: An array of dictionaries that describe a range of client IP addresses to serve.

children.name: RangesItem
children.description: A range of IP addresses to cache.

children.name: type
children.description: The IP address type.

children.name: first
children.description: The first IP address in the range.

children.name: last
children.description: The last IP address in the range.

properties.name: ListenRangesOnly
properties.description: If `true`, the content cache provides content to the clients in the `ListenRanges`.

properties.name: ListenWithPeersAndParents
properties.description: If `true`, the content cache provides content to the clients in the union of the `ListenRanges`, `PeerListenRanges` and `Parents`.

properties.name: LocalSubnetsOnly
properties.description: If `true`, the content cache offers content to clients only on the same immediate local network only. No content is offered to clients on other networks reachable by the content cache. If `LocalSubnetsOnly` is `true`, the system ignores `ListenRanges`.

properties.name: LogClientIdentity
properties.description: If `true`, the Content Cache logs the IP address and port number of the clients that request content.

properties.name: Parents
properties.description: An array of the local IP addresses of other content caches that this cache should download from or upload to, instead of downloading from or uploading to Apple directly. The system ignores invalid addresses and addresses of computers that aren't content caches. The system skips Parent caches that become unavailable. If all parent content caches become unavailable, the content cache downloads from or uploads to Apple directly, until a parent content cache becomes available again.

children.name: ParentsItem
children.description: An IP address.

properties.name: ParentSelectionPolicy
properties.description:
The policy to implement when choosing among more than one configured parent content cache. With every policy, the system skips parent caches that are temporarily unavailable. Allowed values:

* `first-available`: Always use the first available parent in the Parents list. Use this policy to designate permanent primary, secondary, and subsequent parents.
* `url-path-hash`: Hash the path part of the requested URL so that the same parent is always used for the same URL. This is useful for maximizing the size of the combined caches of the parents.
* `random`: Choose a parent at random. Use this policy for load balancing.
* `round-robin`: Rotate through the parents in order. Use this policy for load balancing.
* `sticky-available`: Use the first available parent in the Parents list until it becomes unavailable, then advance to the next one. Use this policy for designating floating primary, secondary, and subsequent parents.

properties.name: PeerFilterRanges
properties.description: An array of dictionaries describing a range of peer IP addresses that the content cache uses to filter its list of peers to query for content. The content cache only queries peers in `PeerFilterRanges`. When `PeerFilterRanges` is an empty array, the content cache doesn't query any peers.

children.name: RangesItem
children.description: A range of IP addresses to cache.

children.name: type
children.description: The IP address type.

children.name: first
children.description: The first IP address in the range.

children.name: last
children.description: The last IP address in the range.

properties.name: PeerListenRanges
properties.description: An array of dictionaries describing a range of peer IP addresses the content cache responds to. When `PeerListenRanges` is an empty array, the content cache responds with an error to all cache queries.

children.name: RangesItem
children.description: A range of IP addresses to cache.

children.name: type
children.description: The IP address type.

children.name: first
children.description: The first IP address in the range.

children.name: last
children.description: The last IP address in the range.

properties.name: PeerLocalSubnetsOnly
properties.description: If `true`, the content cache only peers with other content caches on the same immediate local network, rather than with content caches that use the same public IP address as the device. When `PeerLocalSubnetsOnly` is `true`, it overrides the configuration of `PeerFilterRanges` and `PeerListenRanges`. If the network changes, the local network peering restrictions update appropriately. If `false`, the content cache defers to `PeerFilterRanges` and `PeerListenRanges` for configuring the peering restrictions.

properties.name: Port
properties.description: The TCP port number on which the content cache accepts requests for uploads or downloads. Set to `0` to pick a random, available port.

properties.name: PublicRanges
properties.description: An array of dictionaries describing a range of public IP addresses that the cloud servers should use for matching clients to content caches.

properties.name: Enable
properties.description: Set to `On` to enable FileVault and set to `Off` to disable FileVault. Payloads set to `On` sent through MDM need to either include full authentication information in the payload or have the `Defer` option set to `true`. When `Defer` is `true`, the system prompts for the authentication information when the user enables FileVault.

properties.name: Defer
properties.description: If `true`, the system defers enabling FileVault until the designated user logs out. For details, see `fdesetup(8)`. Only a local user or a mobile account user can enable FileVault.

properties.name: UserEntersMissingInfo
properties.description: If `true`, the system enables a prompt for missing user name or password fields.

properties.name: UseRecoveryKey
properties.description: If `true`, the system creates a personal recovery key and displays it to the user.

properties.name: ShowRecoveryKey
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents display of the personal recovery key to the user after the system enables FileVault.

properties.name: OutputPath
properties.description: The path to the location of the recovery key and computer information property list.

properties.name: Certificate
properties.description: The DER-encoded certificate data if the system creates an institutional recovery key. This key isn't supported on a Mac with Apple silicon.

properties.name: PayloadCertificateUUID
properties.description: The UUID of the payload within the same profile containing the asymmetric recovery key certificate payload.

properties.name: Username
properties.description: The user name of the Open Directory user to add to FileVault.

properties.name: Password
properties.description: The password of the Open Directory user to add to FileVault. Use the `UserEntersMissingInfo` key to prompt for this information.

properties.name: UseKeychain
properties.description: If `true` and you don't include certificate information in this payload, the system uses the keychain created at `/Library/Keychains/FileVaultMaster.keychain` when it adds the institutional recovery key.

properties.name: DeferForceAtUserLoginMaxBypassAttempts
properties.description: The maximum number of times users can bypass enabling FileVault before the system requires the user to enable it to log in. If the value is `0`, the system requires the user to enable FileVault the next time they attempt to log in. Set this key to `-1` to disable this feature.

properties.name: DeferDontAskAtUserLogout
properties.description: If `true`, the system prevents requests to enable FileVault at user logout time.

properties.name: ForceEnableInSetupAssistant
properties.description:
If `true`, and installation of this payload occurs after enrolling with MDM in Setup Assistant, the system requests Setup Assistant to enable FileVault at setup time.

To use this, enable the Await Device Configured ADE configuration option and send this profile with this key set, before sending the `DeviceConfiguredCommand`.

An admin SecureToken user is required, otherwise the FileVault pane doesn't appear.

children.name: Authorization

- `Allow`: Equivalent to a `true` value for the `Allowed` key

collections.description: The payload that configures Apple TV for a particular style of AirPlay security.

properties.name: PayloadIdentifier
properties.description:
The reverse-DNS-style identifier for the payload. This identifier is usually the same as the `TopLevel` value, with an additional appended component. This string must be unique within the profile.

During a profile replacement, the system updates payloads with the same `PayloadIdentifier` and `PayloadUUID` in the old and new profiles.

properties.name: PayloadUUID
properties.description:
The globally unique identifier for the payload. The actual content is unimportant, but must be globally unique. In macOS, use `uuidgen` to generate UUIDs.

During a profile replacement, the system updates payloads with the same `PayloadIdentifier` and `PayloadUUID` in the old and new profiles.

properties.name: PayloadType
properties.description: The payload type, which each payload domain's reference page specifies.

properties.name: PayloadVersion
properties.description: The version of this specific payload.

properties.name: PayloadDescription
properties.description: The human-readable description of this payload. This description appears on the Detail screen.

properties.name: PayloadDisplayName
properties.description: The human-readable name for the profile payload. The name appears on the Detail screen and doesn't need to be unique.

properties.name: PayloadOrganization
properties.description: The human-readable string containing the name of the organization that provides the profile. This value doesn't need to match the organization payload value in the enclosing dictionary.

properties.name: Security type
properties.description:
The security policy for AirPlay. Allowed values:

* `PASSCODE_ONCE`: Requires an onscreen passcode on first connection from a device. Subsequent connections from the same device aren't prompted.
* `PASSCODE_ALWAYS`: Requires an onscreen passcode for every AirPlay connection. After an AirPlay connection ends, the system allows reconnecting within 30 seconds without a password.
* `PASSWORD`: Requires the passphrase set for `Password`.

> Note:
> `NONE` was deprecated in tvOS 11.3. Existing profiles that use `NONE` get the `PASSWORD_ONCE` behavior.

properties.name: Access type
properties.description:
The access policy for AirPlay.

`ANY` allows connections from both Ethernet, Wi-Fi, and Apple Wireless Direct Link.

`WIFI_ONLY` allows connections only from devices on the same Ethernet or Wi-Fi network as Apple TV.

properties.name: Password
properties.description: The AirPlay password; required if `SecurityType` is `PASSWORD`.

properties.name: allowAccountModification
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables modification of accounts, such as Apple Accounts, and internet-based accounts, such as Mail, Contacts, and Calendar.

properties.name: Allow handoff
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables activity continuation. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated. In a future release, this restriction will begin requiring supervision and will apply to personal Apple Accounts only.

properties.name: Allow adding Game Center friends
properties.description: If `false`, the system prohibits adding friends to Game Center. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later.

properties.name: allowAirDrop
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables AirDrop.

properties.name: Allow incoming AirPlay requests
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables incoming AirPlay requests.

properties.name: Allow AirPrint
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables AirPrint.

properties.name: Allow storage of AirPrint credentials in keychain
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables Keychain storage of user name and password for AirPrint.

properties.name: Allow discovery of AirPrint printers using iBeacons
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables iBeacon discovery of AirPrint printers, which prevents spurious AirPrint Bluetooth beacons from phishing for network traffic.

properties.name: Allow modifying cellular data usage for apps settings
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables changing settings for cellular data usage for apps.

properties.name: Allow App Clips
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents a user from adding any App Clips, and removes any existing App Clips on the device.

properties.name: Allow app installation
properties.description:
If `false`, the system disables the App Store and removes its icon from the Home Screen. Users are unable to install or update their apps. This applies to App Store apps, marketplace apps, and locally installed apps (using Configurator, Xcode, and so forth).

In iOS 10 and later, MDM commands can override this restriction. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later.

properties.name: Allow Apple Intelligence report
properties.description:
If `false`, the system disables Apple Intelligence reports.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings` configuration.

properties.name: allowApplePersonalizedAdvertising
properties.description: If `false`, the system limits Apple personalized advertising.

properties.name: Allow app removal
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables removal of apps from an iOS device. This applies to App Store apps, marketplace apps, and locally installed apps (using Configurator, Xcode, and so forth).

properties.name: Allow hiding apps
properties.description: If `false`, disables the ability for the user to hide apps. It doesn't affect the user's ability to leave it in the App Library, while removing it from the Home Screen.

properties.name: Allow locking apps
properties.description: If `false`, disables the ability for the user to lock apps. Because hiding apps also requires locking them, disallowing locking also disallows hiding.

properties.name: Allow modifying Remote Management Sharing setting
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents modifying the Remote Management Sharing setting in System Settings.

properties.name: Allow Siri
properties.description:
If `false`, the system disables Siri.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.siri.settings` configuration.

properties.name: allowAssistantUserGeneratedContent
properties.description:
If `false`, the system prevents Siri from querying user-generated content from the web.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.siri.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow Siri while locked
properties.description:
If `false`, the system disables Siri when the device is locked. The system ignores this restriction if the device doesn't have a passcode set.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.siri.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow auto correction
properties.description:
If `false`, the system disables keyboard autocorrection.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.keyboard.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow auto dim
properties.description: If `false`, disables auto dim on iPads with OLED displays.

properties.name: Allow automatic app downloads
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents automatic downloading of apps purchased on other devices. This setting doesn't affect updates to existing apps.

properties.name: allowAutomaticScreenSaver
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables Apple TV's automatic screen saver.

properties.name: allowAutoUnlock
properties.description: If `false`, the system disallows auto unlock. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

properties.name: Allow modifying Bluetooth settings
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents modification of Bluetooth settings.

properties.name: Allow modifying Bluetooth sharing setting
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents modifying Bluetooth settings in System Settings.

properties.name: Allow Book Store
properties.description: If `false`, the system removes the Book Store tab from the Books app.

properties.name: Allow Book Store erotica
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents the user from downloading Apple Books media that's tagged as erotica. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

properties.name: Allow call recording
properties.description: If `false`, disables call recording.

properties.name: Allow camera use
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables the camera and removes its icon from the Home Screen, and users are unable to take photographs. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

properties.name: allowCellularPlanModification
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents users from changing settings related to their cellular plan (available only on select carriers).

properties.name: Allow use of iMessage
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables the use of iMessage with supervised devices. If the device supports text messaging, the user can still send and receive text messages.

properties.name: allowCloudAddressBook
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Contacts services.

properties.name: Allow iCloud backup
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables backing up the device to iCloud. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

properties.name: allowCloudBookmarks
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Bookmark sync.

properties.name: allowCloudCalendar
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Calendar services.

properties.name: allowCloudDesktopAndDocuments
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Desktop and Document services.

properties.name: Allow iCloud document sync
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables document and key-value syncing to iCloud. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later, and Shared iPad doesn't support it. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated.

properties.name: allowCloudFreeform
properties.description: If `false`, the system disallows iCloud Freeform services.

properties.name: allowCloudKeychainSync
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Keychain synchronization. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated.

properties.name: allowCloudMail
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Mail services.

properties.name: allowCloudNotes
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Notes services.

properties.name: Allow iCloud photo library
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Photo Library. The system removes any photos from local storage that aren't fully downloaded from iCloud Photo Library to the device. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated.

properties.name: allowCloudPrivateRelay
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Private Relay. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated.

properties.name: allowCloudReminders
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Reminder services.

properties.name: allowContentCaching
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables content caching. This restriction is not supported on the user channel.

properties.name: Allow continuous path keyboard
properties.description:
If `false`, the system disables QuickPath keyboard.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.keyboard.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow default browser modification
properties.description: If `false`, disables default browser preference modification. The MDM Settings command to set the default browser preference still works when applying this.

properties.name: Allow default calling app modification
properties.description: If `false`, disables default calling app preference modification. The MDM Settings command to set the default calling app preference still works when applying this.

properties.name: Allow default messaging app modification
properties.description: If `false`, disables default messaging app preference modification. The MDM Settings command to set the default messaging app preference still works when applying this.

properties.name: Allow definition lookup
properties.description:
If `false`, the system disables definition lookup.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.keyboard.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow modifying device name
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents the user from changing the device name.

properties.name: Allow device sleep
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents the device from automatically sleeping.

properties.name: Allow diagnostic submission
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents the device from automatically submitting diagnostic reports to Apple.

properties.name: Allow modifying diagnostics settings
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables changing the diagnostic submission and app analytics settings in the Diagnostics & Usage UI in Settings.

properties.name: Allow dictation
properties.description:
If `false`, the system disallows dictation input.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.keyboard.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allowed exceptions to camera restriction
properties.description: If present, the system exempts apps with bundle IDs in the array from the `allowCamera` restriction. The system doesn't grant these apps access to the camera automatically; they're only exempted from the `allowCamera` restriction. This key has no effect when the camera isn't restricted. Multiple payloads combine using an intersect operation. Requires a supervised device.

properties.name: Allowed external intelligence workspace IDs
properties.description:
An array of strings, but currently restricted to a single element. If present, Apple Intelligence allows use of only the given external integration workspace ID, and requires a sign-in to make requests. The user is required to sign in to integrations that support signing in. Multiple payloads combine using an intersect operation. This means the allowed set of workspace IDs can become the empty set if multiple payloads specify conflicting values.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.external-intelligence.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow configuring restrictions or ScreenTime
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables the Enable Restrictions option in the Restrictions UI in Settings. If `false` in iOS 12 and later, the system disables the Enable ScreenTime option in the ScreenTime UI in Settings and disables ScreenTime if already enabled.

properties.name: Allow trusting enterprise apps
properties.description: If `false`, the system removes the Trust Enterprise Developer button in Settings > General > VPN & Device Management, which prevents provisioning apps by universal provisioning profiles. This restriction applies to free developer accounts and enterprise app developers that aren't implicitly trusted by apps that install through MDM. This restriction doesn't revoke previously granted trust.

properties.name: Allow enterprise books backup
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables backup of Enterprise books.

properties.name: Allow enterprise books notes and highlights sync
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables sync of Enterprise books, notes, and highlights.

properties.name: Allow erase all content and settings
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables the Erase All Content and Settings option in the Reset UI.

properties.name: Allow eSIM modification
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables modifications of eSIMs. This also disables the phone number sharing setup on iPhones, in iOS 27 and later.

properties.name: Allow eSIM outgoing transfers
properties.description: If `false`, prevents the transfer of an eSIM from the device on which the restriction is installed to a different device.

properties.name: Allow explicit content
properties.description:
If `false`, the system hides explicit music or video content purchased from the iTunes Store. The system marks explicit content as such by content providers, such as record labels, when sold through the iTunes Store. Explicit content in the News and Podcast apps is also hidden.

Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

properties.name: Allow external intelligence integrations
properties.description:
If `false`, disables the use of external, cloud-based intelligence services with Siri. In iOS, this restriction is temporarily allowed on unsupervised and user enrollments. In a future release, this restriction will require supervision, and will be ignored on unsupervised devices.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.external-intelligence.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow external intelligence integrations sign-in
properties.description:
If `false`, forces external intelligence providers into anonymous mode. If a user is already signed in to an external intelligence provider, applying this restriction signs them out when attempting the next request.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.external-intelligence.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow modifying file sharing setting
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents modifying File Sharing setting in System Settings.

properties.name: allowFilesNetworkDriveAccess
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents connecting to network drives in the Files app.

properties.name: allowFilesUSBDriveAccess
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents connecting to any connected USB devices in the Files app.

properties.name: allowFindMyDevice
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables Find My Device in the Find My app.

properties.name: allowFindMyFriends
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables Find My Friends in the Find My app.

properties.name: allowFindMyFriendsModification
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables changes to Find My Friends.

properties.name: Allow Touch ID to unlock device
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents Touch ID, Face ID, or Optic ID from unlocking a device. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

properties.name: Allow modifying Touch ID fingerprints
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents the user from modifying Touch ID or Face ID.

properties.name: Allow Game Center
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables Game Center, and the system removes its icon from the Home Screen.

properties.name: Allow Genmoji
properties.description:
If `false`, prohibits creating new Genmoji.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow automatic sync while roaming
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables global background fetch activity when an iOS phone is roaming. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

properties.name: allowHostPairing
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables host pairing with the exception of the supervision host. If there's no configured supervision host certificate, the system disables all pairing. Host pairing lets the administrator control whether an iOS device can pair with a host Mac or PC.

properties.name: Allow Image Playground
properties.description:
If `false`, prohibits the use of image generation.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow Image Wand
properties.description:
If `false`, prohibits the use of Image Wand.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow in app purchases
properties.description: If `false`, the system prohibits in-app purchasing. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

properties.name: Allow modifying internet sharing setting
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents modifying the Internet Sharing setting in System Settings.

properties.name: Allow iPhone mirroring
properties.description: If `false`, prohibits the use of iPhone Mirroring. In macOS, this prevents the Mac from mirroring any iPhone. In iOS, this prevents the iPhone from mirroring to any Mac.

properties.name: Allow iPhone widget on Mac
properties.description: If `false`, the system disallows iPhone widgets on a Mac that signs in with the same Apple Account for iCloud.

properties.name: Allow use of iTunes
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables the iTunes Music Store and removes its icon from the Home Screen. Users can't preview, purchase, or download content. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later.

properties.name: allowiTunesFileSharing
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables iTunes file sharing services.

properties.name: Allow keyboard shortcuts
properties.description:
If `false`, the system disables keyboard shortcuts.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.keyboard.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow listed apps
properties.description:
If present, the system only shows or can launch apps with bundle IDs in the array. Include the value `com.apple.webapp` to allow all webclips. This applies to App Store apps, marketplace apps, and locally installed apps (using Configurator, Xcode, and so forth).

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.app.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow live voicemail
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables live voicemail on the device.

properties.name: Allow creating users in System Settings
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents creating users in System Settings.

properties.name: allowLockScreenControlCenter
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents Control Center from appearing on the Lock Screen.

properties.name: allowLockScreenNotificationsView
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables the Notifications history view on the Lock Screen, so users can't view past notifications. However, they can still see notifications when they arrive.

properties.name: allowLockScreenTodayView
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables the Today view in Notification Center on the Lock Screen.

properties.name: allowMailPrivacyProtection
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables Mail Privacy Protection on the device.

properties.name: allowMailSmartReplies
properties.description:
If `false`, disables smart replies in Mail.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings` configuration.

properties.name: allowMailSummary
properties.description:
If `false`, disables the ability to create summaries of email messages manually. This doesn't affect automatic summary generation.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow iCloud sync for managed apps
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents managed apps from using iCloud sync.

properties.name: Allow managed apps to write to managed contacts accounts
properties.description:
If `true`, the system allows managed apps to write contacts to unmanaged accounts. If `allowOpenFromManagedToUnmanaged` is `true`, this restriction has no effect.

> Important:
> Use MDM to install profiles that contain this restriction.

properties.name: Allow app installation from alternative marketplaces
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents installation of alternative marketplace apps from the web and prevents any installed alternative marketplace apps from installing apps.

properties.name: Allow modifying Media Sharing setting
properties.description: If `false`, prevents modification of Media Sharing settings.

properties.name: Allow multiplayer gaming
properties.description: If `false`, the system prohibits multiplayer gaming.

properties.name: Allow Apple Music
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables the Music service, and the Music app reverts to classic mode.

properties.name: Allow use of News
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables News.

properties.name: allowNFC
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables NFC.

properties.name: allowNotesTranscription
properties.description:
If `false`, disables transcription in Notes.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings` configuration.

properties.name: allowNotesTranscriptionSummary
properties.description:
If `false`, disables transcription summarization in Notes.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow modifying notifications settings
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables modification of notification settings.

properties.name: Enable allow open from managed to unmanaged
properties.description: If `false`, documents in managed apps and accounts open only in other managed apps and accounts.

properties.name: Enable allow open from unmanaged to managed
properties.description: If `false`, documents in unmanaged apps and accounts open only in other unmanaged apps and accounts.

properties.name: allowOTAPKIUpdates
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables over-the-air PKI updates. Setting this restriction to `false` doesn't disable CRL and OCSP checks.

properties.name: Allow pairing with Apple Watch
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables pairing with an Apple Watch, and the system unpairs any currently paired Apple Watch and erases its content.

properties.name: Allow Wallet while locked
properties.description: If `false`, the system hides Passbook notifications from the Lock Screen.

properties.name: Allow modifying passcode
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents adding, changing, or removing the passcode. The system ignores this restriction on Shared iPad.

properties.name: allowPasswordAutoFill
properties.description:
If `false`, the system disables:

- The AutoFill Passwords feature in iOS, with Keychain and third-party password managers
- Prompting the user to use a saved password in Safari or in apps
- Automatic strong passwords
- Suggesting strong passwords to users

However, if `false`, the system doesn't prevent AutoFill for contact info and credit cards in Safari.

properties.name: allowPasswordProximityRequests
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables requesting passwords from nearby devices.

properties.name: allowPasswordSharing
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables sharing passwords with the AirDrop passwords feature, or with the Passwords app.

properties.name: Allow modifying personal hotspot settings
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables modifications of the personal hotspot setting.

properties.name: Allow personalized handwriting results
properties.description:
If false, prevents the system from generating text in the user's handwriting.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow Photo Stream
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables Photo Stream.

properties.name: allowPodcasts
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables podcasts.

properties.name: Allow predictive keyboard
properties.description:
If `false`, the system disables predictive keyboards.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.keyboard.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow modifying Printer Sharing setting
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents modifying Printer Sharing settings in System Settings.

properties.name: allowProximitySetupToNewDevice
properties.description: If `false`, disables the prompt to set up new devices that are nearby. Starting with iOS 26.3, this also prevents exporting iOS data to set up new Android devices.

properties.name: Allow iTunes radio
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables Apple Music Radio.

properties.name: Allow Background Security Improvements installation
properties.description:
If `false`, the system prohibits installation of Background Security Improvements.

Removed: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.softwareupdate.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow Background Security Improvements removal
properties.description:
If `false`, the system prohibits removal of Background Security Improvements.

Removed: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.softwareupdate.settings` configuration.

properties.name: allowRCSMessaging
properties.description: If `false`, prevents the use of RCS messaging.

properties.name: Allow modifying remote Apple Events Sharing setting
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents modifying Remote Apple Events Sharing settings in System Settings.

properties.name: Allow pairing with Remote app
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables pairing Apple TV for use with the Control Center widget.

properties.name: Allow remote screen observation
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables remote screen observation by the Classroom app. Nest this key beneath `allowScreenShot` as a subrestriction. If `allowScreenShot` is `false`, the Classroom app doesn't observe remote screens. Requires a supervised device until iOS 13 and macOS 10.15. Allowed for user enrollments in macOS 12 and later.

properties.name: allowRosettaUsageAwareness
properties.description: If `false`, disables Rosetta usage awareness. When Rosetta usage awareness is active, the device displays a pop-up dialog to the user when launching an app that uses Rosetta. The pop-up dialog indicates that Rosetta will be removed in a future version of the operating system so that the user can contact the app vendor regarding a replacement for the current app.

properties.name: Allow use of Safari
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables the Safari web browser app, and the system removes its icon from the Home Screen. This setting also prevents users from opening web clips. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later.

properties.name: allowSafariHistoryClearing
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables the ability to clear browsing history in Safari.

properties.name: allowSafariPrivateBrowsing
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables the ability to use private browsing in Safari.

properties.name: allowSafariSummary
properties.description:
If `false`, the system disables the ability to summarize content in Safari.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow use of satellite connectivity
properties.description: If `false`, the system prohibits the connection to and use of satellite services.

properties.name: Allow screenshots and screen recording
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables saving a screenshot of the display and capturing a screen recording. It also disables the Classroom app from observing remote screens.

properties.name: allowSharedDeviceTemporarySession
properties.description: If `false`, the system makes temporary sessions unavailable on Shared iPad.

properties.name: Allow shared stream
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables Shared Photo Stream. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

properties.name: Allow Siri Apple Intelligence integration
properties.description:
If `false`, the system disables Apple Intelligence integration in Siri.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.siri.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow spell check
properties.description:
If `false`, the system disables the keyboard spell checker.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.keyboard.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow Siri suggestions
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables Spotlight Internet search results in Siri Suggestions. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

properties.name: Allow modifying startup disk settings
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents modification of Startup Disk settings in System Settings.

properties.name: allowSystemAppRemoval
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables the removal of system apps from the device.

properties.name: Allow modifying Time Machine settings
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents modification of Time Machine settings in System Settings. This restriction isn't supported on the user channel.

properties.name: Allow app installation from app store
properties.description:
If `false`, the system disables the App Store and removes its icon from the Home Screen. However, users can continue to install or update their apps either locally (via Configurator, Xcode, and so forth), or using alternative marketplace apps.

In iOS 10 and later, MDM commands can override this restriction.

properties.name: Allow UI configuration profile installation
properties.description: If `false`, the system prohibits the user from installing configuration profiles and certificates interactively.

properties.name: Allow Universal Control
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables Universal Control.

properties.name: Allow unmanaged apps to read managed contacts accounts
properties.description:
If `true`, the system allows unmanaged apps to read from managed contacts accounts. If `allowOpenFromManagedToUnmanaged` is `true`, this restriction has no effect.

> Important:
> Use MDM to install profiles that contain this restriction.

properties.name: allowUnpairedExternalBootToRecovery
properties.description: If `true`, the system allows unpaired devices to boot devices into recovery.

properties.name: Allow user to accept untrusted TLS certificates
properties.description: If `false`, the system automatically rejects untrusted HTTPS certificates without prompting the user.

properties.name: allowUSBRestrictedMode
properties.description: If `false`, the system allows iOS devices to always connect to USB accessories while locked. In macOS, allows new USB and Thunderbolt accessories, and SD cards to connect without authorization. If the system has Lockdown mode enabled, it ignores this value. This restriction isn't supported on the user channel.

properties.name: Allow video conferencing
properties.description: If `false`, the system hides the FaceTime app. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later.

properties.name: Allow video conferencing remote control
properties.description: If `false`, disables the ability for a remote FaceTime session to request control of the device.

properties.name: Allow visual intelligence summary
properties.description:
If `false`, the system disables visual intelligence summarization.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Allow voice dialing while device is locked
properties.description: If `false`, the system disables voice dialing if the device is locked with a passcode.

properties.name: Allow adding VPN configurations (supervised devices only)
properties.description: If `false`, the system allows only managed apps to create VPN configurations. Prior to iOS 18, the system also allows unmanaged apps to create VPN configurations.

properties.name: Allow modifying wallpaper
properties.description: If `false`, the system prevents changing the wallpaper.

properties.name: Allow app installation from web sites
properties.description: If `false`, the device prevents installation of apps directly from the web.

properties.name: Allow writing tools
properties.description:
If `false`, disables Apple Intelligence writing tools.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings` configuration.

properties.name: autonomousSingleAppModePermittedAppIDs
properties.description: If present, the system allows apps identified by the bundle IDs listed in the array to autonomously enter Single App Mode.

children.name: Apps allow list for autonomous single app mode

properties.name: Blacklisted apps
properties.description: Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.app.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Blocked apps
properties.description:
If present, the system prevents showing or launching apps with bundle IDs in the array. Include the value `com.apple.webapp` to restrict all webclips. This applies to App Store apps, marketplace apps, and locally installed apps (using Configurator, Xcode, and so forth).

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.app.settings` configuration.

> Note:
> Denying system apps may disable other functionality. For example, denying the App Store app may prevent users from accepting the terms and conditions for the user-based Volume Purchase Program (VPP).

properties.name: deniedICCIDsForiMessageFaceTime
properties.description: An array of strings representing ICCIDs of cellular plans. The device prevents use of any matching cellular networks in iMessage and FaceTime. The array must contain no more than 4 ICCID strings.

children.name: Denied ICCID for iMessage and FaceTime
children.description: An ICCID.

properties.name: deniedICCIDsForRCS
properties.description: An array of strings representing ICCIDs of cellular plans. The device prevents use of any matching cellular networks with RCS messaging. The array must contain no more than 4 ICCID strings.

children.name: Denied ICCID for RCS
children.description: An ICCID.

properties.name: enforcedFingerprintTimeout
properties.description: The value, in seconds, after which the fingerprint unlock requires a password to authenticate. The default value is 48 hours.

properties.name: enforcedSoftwareUpdateDelay
properties.description:
How many days to delay a software update on the device. With this restriction in place, the user doesn't see a software update until the specified number of days after the software update release date. The restrictions `forceDelayedAppSoftwareUpdates` and `forceDelayedSoftwareUpdates` use this value.

Removed: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.softwareupdate.settings` configuration.

properties.name: enforcedSoftwareUpdateMajorOSDeferredInstallDelay
properties.description:
This restriction allows the administrator to set the number of days to delay a major software upgrade on the device. When this restriction is in place, the user sees a software upgrade only after the specified delay after the release of the software upgrade. This value controls the delay for `forceDelayedMajorSoftwareUpdates`.

Removed: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.softwareupdate.settings` configuration.

properties.name: enforcedSoftwareUpdateMinorOSDeferredInstallDelay
properties.description:
This restriction allows the administrator to set the number of days to delay a minor OS software update on the device. When this restriction is in place, the user sees a software update only after the specified delay after the release of the software update. This value controls the delay for `forceDelayedSoftwareUpdates`.

Removed: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.softwareupdate.settings` configuration.

properties.name: enforcedSoftwareUpdateNonOSDeferredInstallDelay
properties.description:
This restriction allows the administrator to set the number of days to delay an app software update on the device. When this restriction is in place, the user sees a non-OS software update only after the specified delay after the release of the software. This value controls the delay for `forceDelayedAppSoftwareUpdates`.

Removed: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.softwareupdate.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Treat AirDrop as unmanaged destination
properties.description: If `true`, the system considers AirDrop to be an unmanaged drop target.

properties.name: forceAirPlayIncomingRequestsPairingPassword
properties.description: If `true`, the system forces all devices sending AirPlay requests to this device to use a pairing password. This key isn't supported in tvOS 10.2 and later. Use the AirPlay Security Payload instead.

properties.name: forceAirPlayOutgoingRequestsPairingPassword
properties.description: If `true`, the system forces all devices receiving AirPlay requests from this device to use a pairing password.

properties.name: Disallow AirPrint to destinations with untrusted certificates
properties.description: If `true`, the system requires trusted certificates for TLS printing communication.

properties.name: Enable Siri profanity filter
properties.description:
If `true`, the system forces the use of the profanity filter for Siri and dictation. Requires a supervised device in iOS.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.siri.settings` configuration.

properties.name: forceAuthenticationBeforeAutoFill
properties.description: If `true`, the user needs to authenticate before the system can autofill passwords or credit card information in Safari and apps. If this restriction isn't enforced, the user can toggle this feature in Settings. Only supported on devices with Face ID or Touch ID.

properties.name: forceAutomaticDateAndTime
properties.description: If `true`, the system enables the Set Automatically feature in Date & Time and the user can't disable it. The system updates the device's time zone only when the device can determine its location using a cellular connection or Wi-Fi with location services enabled.

properties.name: forceBypassScreenCaptureAlert
properties.description: If `true`, then the system bypasses the presentation of a screen capture alert.

properties.name: forceClassroomAutomaticallyJoinClasses
properties.description: If `true`, the system automatically gives permission to the teacher's requests without prompting the student.

properties.name: forceClassroomRequestPermissionToLeaveClasses
properties.description: If `true`, a student enrolled in an unmanaged course through Classroom needs to request permission from the teacher to leave the course.

properties.name: forceClassroomUnpromptedAppAndDeviceLock
properties.description: If `true`, the system allows the teacher to lock apps or the device without prompting the student.

properties.name: forceClassroomUnpromptedScreenObservation
properties.description: If `true` and `ScreenObservationPermissionModificationAllowed` is also `true` in the Education payload, a student enrolled in a managed course through the Classroom app automatically gives permission to that course teacher's requests to observe the student's screen without prompting the student.

properties.name: forceDelayedAppSoftwareUpdates
properties.description: If `true`, the system delays user visibility of non-OS software updates. Control visibility of operating system updates through `forceDelayedSoftwareUpdates`. The delay is 30 days unless you set `enforcedSoftwareUpdateDelay` to another value.

properties.name: forceDelayedMajorSoftwareUpdates
properties.description:
If `true`, the system delays user visibility of major OS updates.

Removed: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.softwareupdate.settings` configuration.

properties.name: forceDelayedSoftwareUpdates
properties.description:
If `true`, the system delays user visibility of software updates. In macOS, the system allows seed build updates without delay. The delay is 30 days unless you set `enforcedSoftwareUpdateDelay` to another value.

Removed: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.softwareupdate.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Force encrypted backups
properties.description: If `true`, the system encrypts all backups.

properties.name: Require iTunes password for all purchases
properties.description: If `true`, the system forces the user to enter their iTunes password for each transaction.

properties.name: forceLimitAdTracking
properties.description: If `true`, the system limits ad tracking. Additionally, it disables app tracking and the Allow Apps to Request to Track setting.

properties.name: forceOnDeviceOnlyDictation
properties.description:
If `true`, the system disables connections to Siri servers for the purposes of dictation.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings` configuration.

properties.name: forceOnDeviceOnlyTranslation
properties.description:
If `true`, the device can't connect to Siri servers for the purposes of translation.

Deprecated: use the declarative management `com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings` configuration.

properties.name: Force preserve ESIM on erase
properties.description:
If `true`, the system preserves eSIM when it erases the device due to too many failed password attempts or the Erase All Content and Settings option in Settings > General > Reset.

properties.name: Apps ranking number
properties.description:
The maximum level of app content allowed on the device. Starting with iOS 26.2, this rating may apply to certain system apps.

Age bands and the number of discrete age values vary by region, but the values are consistent across regions. For example, in a region that defines rating level 14+, its value is guaranteed to be larger than 300 (12+) and smaller than 600 (17+). Also, the value of rating level 15+ is guaranteed to be larger than the assigned value of rating level 14+. For more information about age ratings, see [Age ratings values and definitions](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/reference/age-ratings-values-and-definitions).

Below is the complete list of age rating values used across all App Store regions.
- `1000`: All
- `621`: 21+
- `620`: 20+
- `619`: 19+
- `618`: 18+
- `600`: 17+
- `416`: 16+
- `415`: 15+
- `314`: 14+
- `313`: 13+
- `300`: 12+
- `211`: 11+
- `210`: 10+
- `200`: 9+
- `108`: 8+
- `107`: 7+
- `106`: 6+
- `105`: 5+
- `100`: 4+
- `3`: 3+
- `2`: 2+
- `1`: 1+
- `0`: None

This restriction will require supervision in a future release.

properties.name: Apps exempted from rating restrictions
properties.description: If present, the system exempts apps with bundle IDs in the array from age-based rating restrictions. The system uses intersection combine rules to combine multiple payloads and any exceptions that parental control apps provide, including ScreenTime.

properties.name: Movies ranking number
properties.description:
The maximum level of movie content allowed on the device. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

Possible values, with the U.S. description of the rating level:

- `1000`: All
- `500`: NC-17
- `400`: R
- `300`: PG-13
- `200`: PG
- `100`: G
- `0`: None

properties.name: Region code
properties.description: The two-letter key that profile tools use to display the proper ratings for the given region. The client doesn't recognize or report this data.

properties.name: TV shows ranking number
properties.description:
The maximum level of TV content allowed on the device. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

Possible values, with the U.S. description of the rating level:

- `1000`: All
- `600`: TV-MA
- `500`: TV-14
- `400`: TV-PG
- `300`: TV-G
- `200`: TV-Y7
- `100`: TV-Y
- `0`: None

properties.name: requireManagedPasteboard
properties.description: If `true`, the `allowOpenFromManagedToUnmanaged` and `allowOpenFromUnmanagedToManaged` restrictions also limit copy-and-paste functionality.

properties.name: Accept cookies in Safari
properties.description:
Defines the conditions under which the device accepts cookies. The user-facing settings changed in iOS 11, although the possible values remain the same. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated. Allowed values:

- `0`: Enables Prevent Cross-Site Tracking and Block All Cookies, and the user canʼt disable either setting.
- `1` or `1.5`: Enables Prevent Cross-Site Tracking, and the user canʼt disable it. Doesn't enable Block All Cookies, but the user can enable it.
- `2`: Enables Prevent Cross-Site Tracking, but doesn't enable Block All Cookies. The user can toggle either setting.

properties.name: Allow AutoFill in Safari
properties.description:
If `false`, the system disables Safari AutoFill for passwords, contact info, and credit cards, and also prevents using the Keychain for AutoFill. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later.

> Note:
> The system still allows third-party password managers, and apps can use AutoFill.

properties.name: DNS settings
properties.description: A dictionary that defines a configuration for an encrypted DNS server.

children.name: DNS protocol
children.description: The encrypted transport protocol used to communicate with the DNS server.

children.name: Server URL
children.description: The URI template of a DNS-over-HTTPS server, as defined in RFC 8484. This URL needs to use the `https://` scheme, and the system uses the hostname or address in the URL to validate the server certificate. If no `ServerAddresses` are provided, the system uses the hostname or address in the URL to determine the server addresses. Required if `DNSProtocol` is `HTTPS`.

children.name: Server name
children.description: The hostname of a DNS-over-TLS server used to validate the server certificate, as defined in RFC 7858. If no `ServerAddresses` are provided, the system uses the hostname to determine the server addresses. This key must be present only if the DNSProtocol is `TLS`.

children.name: DNS server addresses
children.description: An unordered list of DNS server IP address strings. These IP addresses can be a mixture of IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

children.name: Allow failover
children.description: If `true`, the device allows failover to the default system DNS resolver.

children.name: Certificate UUID
children.description: The UUID that points to an identity certificate payload. The system uses this identity to authenticate the user to the DNS resolver.

children.name: Supplemental match domains
children.description:
A list of domain strings used to determine which DNS queries use the DNS server. If not set, all domains use the DNS server.

The system supports a single wildcard (`\*`) prefix, but it's not required. For example, both `\*.example.com` and `example.com` match against `mydomain.example.com` and `your.domain.example.com`, but don't match against `mydomain-example.com`.

properties.name: On demand rules
properties.description: An array of rules that define the DNS settings. If not set, the system always applies the DNS settings. These rules are identical to the `OnDemandRules` array in VPN payloads.

children.name: On demand action
children.description:
The action to take if this dictionary matches the current network. Allowed values:

- `Connect`: Apply DNS Settings when the dictionary matches.
- `Disconnect`: Don't apply DNS Settings when the dictionary matches.
- `EvaluateConnection`: Apply DNS Settings with per-domain exceptions when the dictionary matches.

children.name: Action parameters
children.description: An array of dictionaries that provide per-connection rules. The system uses this array only for settings where the `Action` value is `EvaluateConnection`.

children.name: Action parameter
children.description:
A dictionary that provides per-connection rules.
The keys allowed in each dictionary are described below. Note: This array is only for dictionaries in which `EvaluateConnection` is the `Action` value.

children.name: Domains
children.description: The domains for which this evaluation applies.

children.name: Domain action
children.description:
The DNS settings behavior for the specified domains. Allowed values:

* 'NeverConnect': Don't use the DNS Settings for the specified domains.
* 'ConnectIfNeeded': Allow using the DNS Settings for the specified domains.

children.name: DNS domain match
children.description:
An array of domain names. This rule matches if any of the domain names in the specified list matches any domain in the device's search domains list.

The system supports a single wildcard (`\*`) prefix, but it's not required. For example, both `\*.example.com` and `example.com` match against `mydomain.example.com` and `your.domain.example.com`, but don't match against `mydomain-example.com`.

children.name: DNS server address match
children.description:
An array of IP addresses. This rule matches if any of the network's specified DNS servers match any entry in the array.

The system supports matching with a single wildcard. For example, `17.\*` matches any DNS server in the 17.0.0.0/8 subnet.

children.name: Interface type match
children.description: An interface type. If specified, this rule matches only if the primary network interface hardware matches the specified type.

children.name: SSID match
children.description: An array of SSIDs to match against the current network. If the network isn't a Wi-Fi network or if the SSID doesn't appear in this array, the match fails. Omit this key and the corresponding array to match against any SSID.

children.name: URL string probe
children.description: A URL to probe. This rule matches if this URL is successfully fetched and returns a 200 HTTP status code without redirection.

properties.name: Prohibit disablement
properties.description: If `true`, the system prohibits users from disabling DNS settings. This key is only available on supervised devices.

properties.name: PayloadType
properties.description: The payload type, which each payload domain's reference page specifies.

properties.name: PayloadVersion
properties.description: The version of this specific payload.

properties.name: PayloadDescription
properties.description: The human-readable description of this payload. This description appears on the Detail screen.

properties.name: PayloadDisplayName

properties.name: PayloadOrganization
properties.description: The human-readable string containing the name of the organization that provides the profile. This value doesn't need to match the organization payload value in the enclosing dictionary.

properties.name: ExtensionIdentifier
properties.description: Set this to `com.apple.AppSSOKerberos.KerberosExtension` for this extension.

properties.name: TeamIdentifier
properties.description: Set this to `apple` for this extension.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Set this to `Credential` for this extension.

properties.name: Realm
properties.description: The Kerberos realm. Use proper capitalization for this value. If in an Active Directory forest, this is the realm where the user logs in.

properties.name: ExtensionData
properties.description: This is the dictionary used by the Apple built-in Kerberos extension.

children.name: cacheName
children.description: The GSS name of the Kerberos cache to use. Rarely set by an administrator.

children.name: principalName
children.description: The principal (username) to use. You don't need to include the realm.

children.name: siteCode
children.description: The name of the Active Directory site the Kerberos extension should use. Most administrators don't need to modify this value, as the Kerberos extension can normally find the site automatically.

children.name: certificateUUID
children.description: The PayloadUUID of a PKINIT certificate.

children.name: useSiteAutoDiscovery
children.description: If `false`, the Kerberos extension doesn't automatically use LDAP and DNS to determine its AD site name.

children.name: credentialBundleIdACL
children.description: A list of bundle IDs allowed to access the ticket-granting ticket (TGT).

children.name: credentialBundleIdACLItem
children.description: Bundle IDs allowed to access the TGT. These values are case sensitive.

children.name: includeManagedAppsInBundleIdACL
children.description: If `true`, the Kerberos extension allows only managed apps to access and use the credential. This is in addition to the `credentialBundleIDACL`, if you specify that value.

children.name: includeKerberosAppsInBundleIdACL
children.description: If `true`, the Kerberos extension allows the standard Kerberos utilities including `TicketViewer` and `klist` to access and use the credential. This is in addition to `includeManagedAppsInBundleIdACL` or the `credentialBundleIdACL`, if you specify those values.

children.name: domainRealmMapping
children.description: A custom domain-realm mapping for Kerberos. The system uses this when the DNS name of hosts doesn't match the realm name. Most administrators don't need to customize this.

children.name: Realm
children.description: The key should be the name of the realm, and the value is an array of DNS suffixes that map to the realm.

children.name: RealmItem
children.description: Domains to map to the realm

children.name: isDefaultRealm
children.description: Specifies whether this is the default realm if there's more than one Kerberos extension configuration.

children.name: customUsernameLabel
children.description: The custom user name label used in the Kerberos extension instead of "Username," such as "Company ID".

children.name: helpText
children.description: The text to display to the user at the bottom of the Kerberos Login Window. You can also use this to display help information or disclaimer text.

children.name: allowPasswordChange
children.description: If `false`, the system disables password changes.

children.name: allowAutomaticLogin
children.description: If `false`, the system doesn't allow saving passwords in the keychain.

children.name: requireUserPresence
children.description: If `true`, the system requires the user to provide Touch ID, Face ID or their passcode to access the keychain entry.

children.name: pwExpireOverride
children.description: The number of days that the system allows using passwords on this domain. For most domains, this calculation is automatic.

children.name: pwNotificationDays
children.description: The number of days prior to password expiration when the system sends a notification of password expiration to the user.

children.name: pwReqLength
children.description: The minimum length of passwords on the domain.

children.name: pwReqComplexity
children.description: If `true`, the system requires passwords to meet Active Directory's definition of "complex".

children.name: pwReqMinAge
children.description: The minimum age of passwords before the system allows changing them on this domain.

children.name: pwReqHistory
children.description: The number of prior passwords that the system disallows reuse on this domain.

children.name: pwReqText
children.description: The text version of the domain's password requirements. Only for use if `pwReqComplexity` or `pwReqLength` aren't specified.

children.name: pwReqRTFData
children.description: The RTF file formatted version of the domain's password requirements. Only for use if `pwReqComplexity` or `pwReqLength` aren't specified.

children.name: pwChangeURL
children.description: This URL will launch in the user's default web browser when they initiate a password change.

children.name: syncLocalPassword
children.description: If `false`, the system disables password sync. Note that this will not work if the user is logged in with a mobile account.

children.name: replicationTime
children.description: The time, in seconds, required to replicate changes in the Active Directory domain. The Kerberos extension uses this when checking password age after a change.

children.name: delayUserSetup
children.description: If `true`, the system doesn't prompt the user to setup the Kerberos extension until either the administrator enables it with the `app-sso` tool or the system receives a Kerberos challenge.

children.name: monitorCredentialsCache
children.description: If `false`, the system requests the credential on the next matching Kerberos challenge or network state change. If the credential is expired or missing, the system creates a new one.

children.name: requireTLSForLDAP
children.description: Require that LDAP connections use TLS.

children.name: credentialUseMode
children.description:
This setting affects how other processes use the Kerberos Extension credential. Allowed values:

- `always`: The system always uses the credential if the SPN matches the Kerberos Extension `Hosts` array and the caller hasn't specified another credential. However, the system won't use the credential if the calling app isn't in the `credentialBundleIDACL`.
- `whenNotSpecified`: The system only uses the extension credential if the SPN matches the Kerberos Extension `Hosts` array. However, the system won't use the credential if the calling app isn't in the `credentialBundleIDACL`.
- `kerberosDefault`: The system uses the default Kerberos processes to select credentials, and normally uses the default Kerberos credential. This is the same as turning off this capability.

children.name: preferredKDCs
children.description:
The ordered list of preferred Key Distribution Centers (KDCs) to use for Kerberos traffic. Use this if the servers aren't discoverable through DNS. If you specify the servers, the system uses them for both connectivity checks and attempts to use them first for Kerberos traffic. If the servers don't respond, the device falls back to DNS discovery. Format each entry the same as it would be in a `krb5.conf` file, for example:

- `adserver1.example.com`
- `tcp/adserver1.example.com:88`
- `kkdcp://kerberosproxy.example.com:443/kkdcp`

children.name: preferredKDC
children.description: A host or domain name in the format of [protocol/]hostname[:port][/path]

children.name: usePlatformSSOTGT
children.description: If `true`, the system requires this configuration uses a TGT from Platform SSO instead of requesting a new one.

children.name: allowPlatformSSOAuthFallback
children.description: If `true` and `usePlatformSSOTGT` is `true`, the system allows the user to manually sign in.

children.name: performKerberosOnly
children.description: If `true`, the Kerberos Extension handles Kerberos requests only. It doesn't check for password expiration, show the password expiration in the menu, check for external password changes, perform password sync, or retrieve the home directory.

children.name: identityIssuerAutoSelectFilter
children.description: A string with wildcards that can use used to filter the list of available SmartCards by issuer. e.g "\*My CA2\*". If there's one remaining, it will be auto-selected. If there more than one remaining, then the list is shorter.

children.name: allowSmartCard
children.description: If `true`, allow the user to switch the user interface to SmartCard mode.

children.name: allowPassword
children.description: If `true`, allow the user to switch the user interface to Password mode.

children.name: startInSmartCardMode
children.description: If `true`, the user interface will start in SmartCard mode.

properties.name: Hosts

One or more host or domain names for which the app extension performs SSO.

- Requires that all the host and domain names of all installed Extensible SSO payloads are unique

> Note:
> Host names that begin with a "." are wildcard suffixes that match all subdomains; otherwise the host name needs be an exact match.

children.name: EnableCreateUserAtLogin
children.description: Enables creating users at the Login Window with an `AuthenticationMethod` of either `Password` or `SmartCard`. Requires that `UseSharedDeviceKeys` is `true`.

children.name: EnableCreateFirstUserDuringSetup
